name: mission.route
description: Advisory System-1 classification of a natural-language mission into one meta-skill lane. Never grants execution authority.

lane.instructions: Choose the single best work lane for the user's task. Choose no_match when unclear or multiple lanes are equally central.

criteria.when-building-or-fixing-agents: Build, evaluate, or repair agents, prompts, skills, or agent harnesses
criteria.when-shipping-code: Implement, debug, test, review, or ship software code
criteria.when-working-with-data: Build or analyze data pipelines, databases, or datasets
criteria.when-securing-the-estate: Investigate or improve security, access, secrets, or incident response
criteria.when-designing-interfaces: Design or improve UI, UX, or accessibility
criteria.when-researching-or-deciding: Research evidence or compare options before a decision
criteria.when-selling-or-running-gtm: Sales, lead generation, GTM, or campaign planning
criteria.when-writing-content: Write or edit articles, copy, newsletters, or other content
criteria.no_match: Intent is vague, ambiguous, or outside these lanes
